## Change

<!-- What changes for the user. One line per item. -->

## Feature docs (required for `feat`)

- [ ] `docs/features/<feature>.md` added or changed, with a `Since:` line
- [ ] Demo image in `docs/images/` (test in `frontend/tests/docs/demo-images.spec.ts`, then `npm run docs:images`)
- [ ] Entry under `## [Unreleased]` in `CHANGELOG.md` with doc link and image
- [ ] Row in `docs/features/README.md`

Rules: [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md#feature-docs-and-releases)
